## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who benefits from it?

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Case

Describe a concrete use case for this feature.

## Additional Context

- Is this related to an existing feature?
- Are there similar features in other platforms?
- Would you be willing to contribute a PR?
